titulo: Where to go with a small child
resumo: Places that actually work, by age range, and what to bring so you do not have to head home early.

secoes.titulo: A baby who is not walking yet
itens: A park with shade and a blanket on the ground. Watching leaves move is more entertaining than it sounds.
The market in the morning: noise, colour and smells, and you get the week's shopping done as well.
The beach or a lake late in the afternoon, when the sun is weak.
A square with uneven ground: grass, sand, gravel. Tiring and fun at the same time.
A nursery, botanical garden or plant centre. Usually cheap or free, and shaded.
An aquarium or a butterfly house, if your town has one.
A short flat trail with a goal at the end: a bridge, a stream, a big rock.
Water and a piece of fruit.
Leaving the house before ten or after four. Nobody copes in the middle of the day.
